newsitem.title: MEXICO: Venezuela Sidor sell-off seen by end-March 1997.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Sidor sell-off seen by end-March 1997.

text.p: The chairman of Venezuela's state-owned steel firm Sidor said Tuesday he expected the privatisation of its three million tonne per year capacity complex to be completed by the end of March 1997.
"At the end of March the process should be concluded," Teolindo Yanez told reporters at the Latin American Steel Congress currently taking place here in northern Mexico.

Yanez said 11 companies had shown interest in the sell-off but because of the move of some of those firms to group together he anticipated that only five groups would put forward bids in the final stages of the process.
Yanez said one small part of the Sidor company which produces seamless tubular steel pipes would be sold off separately.
He added that for obvious reasons the Venezuelan government had not put a price on the sale of the main Sidor complex.
